keyword: concrete pump hopper capacity on the order

title.en: Electric 20 is 0.25 m³ is the concrete pump hopper capacity on the order cell under “California Pipe Flow Example”
title.zh: 「电动15的表上没有这个数字。」是「加州管流法 管道 流量 示例」下面的订邢台的泵之前先读料斗格格子

description.en: concrete pump hopper capacity on the order at /products/electric-20-concrete-pump. Electric 20 is 0.25 m³ The rural diesel is 0.2 m³
description.zh: 订邢台的泵之前先读料斗格见 /products/electric-20-concrete-pump。电动15的表上没有这个数字。农村柴油泵是 0.2 m³。

h1.en: Keep concrete pump hopper capacity on the order under “California Pipe Flow Calculator - Imperial Units” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「加州管流法 管道 流量 计算器 - 英制单位」下保留订邢台的泵之前先读料斗格，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for concrete pump hopper capacity on the order. The row to open is /products/electric-20-concrete-pump. Electric 20 is 0.25 m³. The rural diesel is 0.2 m³. Electric 10 Series is 0.1 m³. LZ-80 and Diesel 120 are 0.6 m³. Electric Low Pressure 60 is 0.5 m³. Electric 60 and Electric 80 are 0.7 m³. A 0.4 m³ hopper is not a formula for m³/h. That figure is not on the Electric 15 sheet. Electric 30 and Electric Low Pressure 40 are 0.3 m³. Both the electric mixer and the diesel mixer print 0.4 m³. Tractor-Driven 4100 does: 0.25 m³, the same figure as Electric 20, on a different machine. Electric 40, Electric 50, Diesel 40, Diesel 50, Diesel 60 and both mixer pumps are 0.4 m³. Electric 15, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60 do not print a hopper volume on the lists used here. The section title “California Pipe Flow Example” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是订邢台的泵之前先读料斗格的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-20-concrete-pump。电动15的表上没有这个数字。农村柴油泵是 0.2 m³。电动20是 0.25 m³。电动10系列是 0.1 m³。电动低压60是 0.5 m³。电动60和电动80是 0.7 m³。电动30和电动低压40是 0.3 m³。电动搅拌泵和柴油搅拌泵都印 0.4 m³。0.4 m³ 料斗不是 m³/h 的公式。LZ-80 和柴油120是 0.6 m³。拖拉机带动4100印了：0.25 m³，数字与电动20相同，机器不同。电动40、电动50、柴油40、柴油50、柴油60和两台搅拌泵是 0.4 m³。电动15、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 在此处使用的列表上不印料斗容积。节标题「加州管流法 管道 流量 示例」来自来源页，不另加额定值。

heading.zh: 加州管流法 管道 流量 示例

body.en: concrete pump hopper capacity on the order is unchanged by the heading “California Pipe Flow Example”. Electric 20 is 0.25 m³. LZ-80 and Diesel 120 are 0.6 m³. A 0.4 m³ hopper is not a formula for m³/h. Both the electric mixer and the diesel mixer print 0.4 m³. Electric 15, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60 do not print a hopper volume on the lists used here.
body.zh: 订邢台的泵之前先读料斗格不因标题「加州管流法 管道 流量 示例」而改动。电动20是 0.25 m³。LZ-80 和柴油120是 0.6 m³。电动搅拌泵和柴油搅拌泵都印 0.4 m³。0.4 m³ 料斗不是 m³/h 的公式。电动15、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 在此处使用的列表上不印料斗容积。

heading.en: California Pipe Flow Calculator - Imperial Units
heading.zh: 加州管流法 管道 流量 计算器 - 英制单位

body.en: This section is titled “California Pipe Flow Calculator - Imperial Units”. concrete pump hopper capacity on the order still prints the cells below. The rural diesel is 0.2 m³. Electric Low Pressure 60 is 0.5 m³. That figure is not on the Electric 15 sheet. Tractor-Driven 4100 does: 0.25 m³, the same figure as Electric 20, on a different machine.
body.zh: 本节标题是「加州管流法 管道 流量 计算器 - 英制单位」。订邢台的泵之前先读料斗格下面这些格子仍是印出来的。农村柴油泵是 0.2 m³。电动低压60是 0.5 m³。电动15的表上没有这个数字。拖拉机带动4100印了：0.25 m³，数字与电动20相同，机器不同。

heading.en: California Pipe Flow Calculator - Metric Units
heading.zh: 加州管流法 管道 流量 计算器 - 公制单位

body.en: Under “California Pipe Flow Calculator - Metric Units”, concrete pump hopper capacity on the order contributes only the printed cells in this part. Electric 10 Series is 0.1 m³. Electric 60 and Electric 80 are 0.7 m³. Electric 30 and Electric Low Pressure 40 are 0.3 m³. Electric 40, Electric 50, Diesel 40, Diesel 50, Diesel 60 and both mixer pumps are 0.4 m³. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/california-pipe-flow-metering-method-d_1975.html.
body.zh: 在「加州管流法 管道 流量 计算器 - 公制单位」下，订邢台的泵之前先读料斗格这一节只放已印出的格子。电动10系列是 0.1 m³。电动60和电动80是 0.7 m³。电动30和电动低压40是 0.3 m³。电动40、电动50、柴油40、柴油50、柴油60和两台搅拌泵是 0.4 m³。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/california-pipe-flow-metering-method-d_1975.html。

question.en: Does “California Pipe Flow Example” replace Electric 20 is 0.25 m³?
question.zh: 「加州管流法 管道 流量 示例」会替换「电动15的表上没有这个数字。」吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 20 is 0.25 m³ remains the printed wording for concrete pump hopper capacity on the order.
answer.zh: 不会。电动15的表上没有这个数字。仍是订邢台的泵之前先读料斗格已印的说法。

question.en: Where does The rural diesel is 0.2 m³ belong on the concrete pump hopper capacity on the order row?
question.zh: 订邢台的泵之前先读料斗格这一行里，「农村柴油泵是 0.2 m³。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-20-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-20-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “California Pipe Flow Calculator - Imperial Units” add to concrete pump hopper capacity on the order?
question.zh: 「加州管流法 管道 流量 计算器 - 英制单位」给订邢台的泵之前先读料斗格增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/california-pipe-flow-metering-method-d_1975.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/california-pipe-flow-metering-method-d_1975.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
